title: Ox Passion Bru Pop Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Bru Pop delivers a bold and nostalgic taste, capturing the unmistakable flavour of a classic Scottish soft drink. Bursting with deep caramelised fruit notes and a subtle citrus zing, this unique e-liquid offers a distinctive, sweet, and slightly spiced soda-inspired vape. With a 50VG/50PG blend, this nicotine salt e-liquid is tailored for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring smooth nicotine delivery with well-defined flavour and a consistently satisfying throat hit. Designed for use with low-powered pod kits and starter devices, it provides rapid nicotine absorption for an enjoyable and convenient vaping experience. Produced by Oxva, a leader in vaping innovation, the OX Passion Salts collection brings expertly crafted flavours that are designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
